sentence: This project builds tools that learn compact models of long-term behavior in complex stochastic systems from short bursts of simulation data.
This project tests a wireless brain implant that uses light to control specific neurons without needing a battery.
This project builds computing tools that help design printable materials with desirable properties.
This project studies how well models trained on satellite imagery work across different regions, sensors and tasks.
This project builds quantum computing hardware whose qubits flag where errors happen, making the errors easier to correct.
This project builds a system that lets two brains pass information directly using brain activity and focused ultrasound stimulation.
This project builds a DNA tool that applies controlled tension to individual integrin proteins to see how they respond to mechanical forces.
This project builds tools that let robots and virtual agents speak and understand speech one word at a time.
This project builds open cookbooks of reusable workflows that help geoscientists analyze data in the cloud.
This project develops digital twins, which are replicas of machines or processes that use real-time data to predict system health and product quality.
This project builds a method that forecasts maize yields on small farm plots using high resolution satellite imagery.
This project plans a metadata service that helps researchers and artificial intelligence tools find scientific data by its meaning.
This project studies how symmetry in microfluidic flow can be used to handle swimming microorganisms without disturbing them.
This project builds methods that use fuzzing to find vulnerabilities in large software more efficiently.
This project builds a flat antenna array that steers terahertz beams for wireless links using computer-generated light patterns.
This project studies how long-lasting ice patches formed and persisted, and what their ice records about past climate and environments.
